SELECT * FROM EDS.TRU_TRUPRODUCTS

--TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.TRU_TRUPRODUCTS
DECLARE @DatetoProcessed DATE
SET @DatetoProcessed = '2024-01-08';

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS_SELECT_SRC
(
                PRODUCT_CODE,
                PRODUCT_NAME,
                PRODUCT_DESC,
                INV_TYPE,
                MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
                MIN_AMT,
                MIN_CURRENCY,
                MAX_AMT,
                MAX_CURRENCY,
                AUM_NOM,
                DOCS_REQD,
                REMARKS,
                PROD_CLASS,
                STATUS,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                REJECT_REASON,
                BR_CD,
                RESERVE_PER,
                FILE_NAME,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                PRODUCT_CODE,
                PRODUCT_NAME,
                PRODUCT_DESC,
                INV_TYPE,
                MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
                MIN_AMT,
                MIN_CURRENCY,
                MAX_AMT,
                MAX_CURRENCY,
                AUM_NOM,
                DOCS_REQD,
                REMARKS,
                PROD_CLASS,
                STATUS,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                REJECT_REASON,
                BR_CD,
                RESERVE_PER,
                FILE_NAME,
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS_SELECT_SRC
(
                PRODUCT_CODE,
                PRODUCT_NAME,
                PRODUCT_DESC,
                INV_TYPE,
                MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
                MIN_AMT,
                MIN_CURRENCY,
                MAX_AMT,
                MAX_CURRENCY,
                AUM_NOM,
                DOCS_REQD,
                REMARKS,
                PROD_CLASS,
                STATUS,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                REJECT_REASON,
                BR_CD,
                RESERVE_PER,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.PRODUCT_CODE,
                CC.PRODUCT_NAME,
                CC.PRODUCT_DESC,
                CC.INV_TYPE,
                CC.MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
                CC.MIN_AMT,
                CC.MIN_CURRENCY,
                CC.MAX_AMT,
                CC.MAX_CURRENCY,
                CC.AUM_NOM,
                CC.DOCS_REQD,
                CC.REMARKS,
                CC.PROD_CLASS,
                CC.STATUS,
                CC.AUTH_ID,
                CC.AUTH_DATE,
                CC.MAKER_ID,
                CC.MAKER_DATE,
                CC.REJECT_REASON,
                CC.BR_CD,
                CC.RESERVE_PER,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.TRU_TRUPRODUCTS CC
            JOIN d360.STG_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS B
            ON CC.PRODUCT_CODE = B.PRODUCT_CODE
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS_GROUP_SRC
(
                PRODUCT_CODE,
                PRODUCT_NAME,
                PRODUCT_DESC,
                INV_TYPE,
                MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
                MIN_AMT,
                MIN_CURRENCY,
                MAX_AMT,
                MAX_CURRENCY,
                AUM_NOM,
                DOCS_REQD,
                REMARKS,
                PROD_CLASS,
                STATUS,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                REJECT_REASON,
                BR_CD,
                RESERVE_PER,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                PRODUCT_CODE,
                PRODUCT_NAME,
                PRODUCT_DESC,
                INV_TYPE,
                MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
                MIN_AMT,
                MIN_CURRENCY,
                MAX_AMT,
                MAX_CURRENCY,
                AUM_NOM,
                DOCS_REQD,
                REMARKS,
                PROD_CLASS,
                STATUS,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                REJECT_REASON,
                BR_CD,
                RESERVE_PER,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                PRODUCT_CODE,
                PRODUCT_NAME,
                PRODUCT_DESC,
                INV_TYPE,
                MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
                MIN_AMT,
                MIN_CURRENCY,
                MAX_AMT,
                MAX_CURRENCY,
                AUM_NOM,
                DOCS_REQD,
                REMARKS,
                PROD_CLASS,
                STATUS,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                REJECT_REASON,
                BR_CD,
                RESERVE_PER,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                PRODUCT_CODE,
                PRODUCT_NAME,
                PRODUCT_DESC,
                INV_TYPE,
                MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
                MIN_AMT,
                MIN_CURRENCY,
                MAX_AMT,
                MAX_CURRENCY,
                AUM_NOM,
                DOCS_REQD,
                REMARKS,
                PROD_CLASS,
                STATUS,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                REJECT_REASON,
                BR_CD,
                RESERVE_PER
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FullDate = @DatetoProcessed;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.TRU_TRUPRODUCTS A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.PRODUCT_CODE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.PRODUCT_CODE,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.TRU_TRUPRODUCTS
(
                PRODUCT_CODE,
                PRODUCT_NAME,
                PRODUCT_DESC,
                INV_TYPE,
                MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
                MIN_AMT,
                MIN_CURRENCY,
                MAX_AMT,
                MAX_CURRENCY,
                AUM_NOM,
                DOCS_REQD,
                REMARKS,
                PROD_CLASS,
                STATUS,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                REJECT_REASON,
                BR_CD,
                RESERVE_PER,
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                PRODUCT_CODE,
                PRODUCT_NAME,
                PRODUCT_DESC,
                INV_TYPE,
                MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
                MIN_AMT,
                MIN_CURRENCY,
                MAX_AMT,
                MAX_CURRENCY,
                AUM_NOM,
                DOCS_REQD,
                REMARKS,
                PROD_CLASS,
                STATUS,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                REJECT_REASON,
                BR_CD,
                RESERVE_PER,
				@DatetoProcessed,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5),
				'TRU',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
